h1: Wix audit, a clear review of your site
overview: We review your Wix site the way a new visitor and a search engine would, and write down what we find. The audit covers speed, mobile layout, SEO basics, forms, bookings and store settings if you sell online, plus apps that slow the site down. You receive a plain report with problems sorted by importance and a simple fix for each. Add a 1-on-1 call and we go through it together.

faq: Invite us as a collaborator with view-only permissions, or send the site link and we review it from the outside. We never need your password and we change nothing during an audit.
Do you fix things as part of the audit?
The audit is a report. You can use the fix list yourself, give it to your developer or order our Wix design edits, SEO or conversion services, which we can quote straight from the report.
Can you audit a Wix Studio site?
Yes. The checks are the same for Wix and Wix Studio, with extra attention to responsive breakpoints on Studio sites, where mobile layouts are set by hand.
Do I get the call with every package?
The 30-minute call comes with Premium. You can add it to Basic or Standard, and we book it after the report is delivered, so you can ask questions about what you read.
